title.value: AU Base Pathology Result (TEST - mandatory specificDiscipline)

description.value: TEST ARTEFACT - NOT FOR PUBLICATION. Derived from AU Base Pathology Result purely to exercise Observation.category slicing. It raises Observation.category:specificDiscipline to 1..1 so that the required binding to the NCTS Pathology Diagnostic Service Category value set must be satisfied by a discriminated slice. Used to demonstrate that the slice discriminator and its constraints operate, rather than silently matching nothing.

short.value: Specific discipline of pathology (mandatory in this test profile)
